answer: Pay agents through a slow river, not a bucket: each reward vests over 30 epochs before it reaches the wharf where it can be withdrawn. Until then, anyone who proves two IDs share keys, hosts or reused work claims the unvested pay of the whole linked set. A sybil farm is karst: solid on top, hollow below, and one sinkhole exposes every tunnel, so the bounty grows with clone count. The 30-epoch window is my assumption.
